sourceReviewCorrection: Copy each supplied buffer into the owned frame before asynchronous hashing; a new regression verifies caller-buffer reuse cannot alter encoded bytes. Final workerd rerun uses a distinct owner and matches the earlier independently materialized archive exactly.
limitations: Prototype four-object dependency copy proves raw-content recovery; it does not by itself recreate loose upload/theme objects for current asset-serving routes. Full legacy materialization includes their verified replicas.
24 checks and local workerd validate the module. No native WordPress save/reopen/logout flow uses this format yet.
Measured bytes are one cumulative delta and its full manifest, not a complete workflow capacity, CPU, latency or whole-isolate memory result.
Compatibility readers, persistence fallback, backup graph/export/import, pins and rollback guards must be integrated and tested before enabling any writer.
